description: This file defines the FimPromptBuilder class responsible for constructing prompts and executing FIM-based completions in a code auto-completion system. It imports types, helper functions, and models, and contains methods for building prompts and processing model responses.

classes.name: FimPromptBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds FIM prompts and executes FIM-based completions using a language model.

methods.name: getFimPrompts
methods.description: Builds a complete FIM prompt with all necessary data based on input and model name.

methods.name: getFromFIM
methods.description: Executes a FIM-based completion using the provided model and prompt, processes the response, and returns the completion result.
